# Rentopya

Rentopya is a multi-company, multi-branch car rental SaaS. Monorepo: Go HTTP API + Asynq worker (`backend/`), Next.js BFF with the platform panel `/platform`, the company panel `/t/{slug}` and the customer portal `/r/{orgSlug}` (`frontend/`), and the branded site app serving every company's site by host (`site/`). Organizations are resolved per request from the `X-Organization` header; tenant permissions come from the member's roles in that organization. Stores: PostgreSQL, Redis, SeaweedFS (S3), Meilisearch, Centrifugo. Integrations: iyzico, Netgsm SMS, WhatsApp (wuzapi), e-invoice (go-ubltr), KABİS, HGS, Yolcu360, Obilet.

## Start here

- AGENTS.md — agent entry, hard rules, skill index (.agents/skills/)
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — repo map, shells, modules, engines, RBAC
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md — env, make local-dev, provider fakes, Dokploy
- docs/EXTENDING.md — how to add a tenant / platform module or a provider
- docs/design/ — one design doc per domain area
- docs/brand.md — Rentopya brand kit, colors, kept `rentopia` identifiers
- backend/API_CONVENTIONS.md — HTTP envelope, lists, route prefixes
- backend/docs/auth.md — JWT, platform and tenant RBAC
- frontend/README.md — BFF, panels, features

Canonical env: repo-root `.env`. Login: /platform/login. API: /v1/... (`/v1/platform`, `/v1/tenant`, `/v1/customer/{orgSlug}`, `/v1/public`).
